pages.text: $(l)Potion of Inspiration$()$(br)Brewing stand: an awkward potion and alchemical essence.$(br2)It gives 3 minutes of $(l)Inspiration$():$(li)affix materials drop twice as often from your kills$(li)right-clicking a bed takes you into the $(l)Spirit Realm$() instead of to sleep (the Inspiration is spent)

$(l)The Spirit Realm$()$(br)Where the spirits of all living things gather: huge floating islands, each one biome from the Overworld, the Nether or the End, with that biome's structures on it.$(br2)There is no day, only an endless starry night: the seven colours of the seven sins flow across it as aurora, and motes of spirit-light drift in the air.

$(l)Spirits$()$(br)Every creature there is a see-through spirit from any world, on any island:$(li)x1.5 health and attack, +4 armor, faster$(li)twice the loot and experience$(li)affix materials twice as often (four times when inspired)$(li)affixed spirits may drop alchemy recipes, and chests often hold them

$(l)Coming back$()$(li)Drink Inspiration again in the realm to return where you dreamed$(li)Falling off the islands or dying there also throws you back, losing nothing, but with 1 minute of $(l)Spirit Shatter$(): every attribute 20% lower, and milk does not cure it$(br2)$(l)Going back in$(): the first time you arrive on the arrival island; after leaving by Inspiration you come back where you left; thrown out any other way (a death, a fall), on a random island up to 10000 blocks from where it happened.$(br2)Beds do not work in the realm.

$(l)Above the islands$()$(li)$(l)Sky Sanctums$(): quartz temples over some islands, climbed by a spiral of floating steps round a hanging chain, a chest on the altar (one always floats over the arrival island)$(li)$(l)Sin Spires$(): towers of one sin's coloured glass standing where there is no island, a chest at the foot$(li)$(l)Spirit Halos$(): great tilted rings round an amethyst core$(li)$(l)Spirit Lanterns$(): soul lanterns scattered through the sky
